articles.t: Un bug du téléphone ouvre la vue subjective dans GTA 6, le streaming pousse à 120 FPS
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 passe en vue subjective grâce à un bug du téléphone. Sur PC, Veyra permet de traiter le flux vidéo avec le DLSS 5, jusqu’à 120 FPS par génération d’images.
articles.txt:
Ranger son téléphone tout en martelant une touche suffit apparemment à changer de perspective dans Los Santos. Associée à un traitement du flux vidéo sur PC, cette manipulation donne des séquences étonnantes, mais ne transforme pas pour autant le jeu en version native pour ordinateur.
Le vidéaste DVESF montre sur YouTube une méthode permettant d’activer une vue à la première personne dans Grand Theft Auto VI. La manipulation consiste à appuyer de façon répétée sur le bouton de changement de caméra pendant que le personnage range son téléphone. Ce comportement semble relever d’un glitch, plutôt que d’une option accessible dans les réglages.
Sa démonstration combine cette caméra avec Veyra , un logiciel open source de streaming de jeux, et le DLSS 5. La vidéo présente des séquences à 60 FPS où le point de vue rapproché et le traitement de l’image donnent un rendu particulièrement réaliste.
Cette expérimentation intervient alors que l’accueil très positif du jeu s’accompagne de nombreux échanges sur ses performances. Plusieurs signalements évoquent notamment des difficultés sur certaines PS5 : la charge graphique mettrait en évidence des problèmes liés au vieillissement de leur interface thermique à métal liquide, y compris à 30 FPS.
Des utilisateurs PC expérimentent donc une autre chaîne d’affichage : récupérer le jeu en streaming, puis appliquer le DLSS 5 au flux. Avec la Multi Frame Generation (MFG) , les essais rapportés atteignent jusqu’à 120 FPS. Ce plafond reste distinct des 60 FPS montrés dans la démonstration de DVESF.
Le point technique compte : générer des images sur le flux reçu ne revient pas à accélérer le rendu sur la console. Cette méthode peut améliorer la fluidité affichée, mais elle ne constitue pas une correction des difficultés thermiques rapportées sur les PS5 concernées.
La sortie PC de GTA VI est attendue courant 2027 . L’hypothèse d’une vue subjective prévue pour cette échéance circule, sans confirmation ni garantie qu’un tel mode officiel voie le jour. Le glitch du téléphone offre néanmoins une piste aux futurs moddeurs PC, qui pourraient exploiter cette possibilité pour proposer leur propre caméra.

articles.t: Vehicles - GTA 6 Guide - IGN
articles.chapeau: It wouldn't be Grand Theft Auto 6 without some vehicles to thieve. Whether you're looking to fence some cars for cash or fill out a garage with your
articles.txt:
It wouldn't be Grand Theft Auto 6 without some vehicles to thieve. Whether you're looking to fence some cars for cash or fill out a garage with your collection, IGN's Vehicle guide has a list of planes, trains, and automobiles just waiting for you to snatch up.
You need to discover at least 200 Vehicles to fulfill GTA 6's 100% requirement , and fence $100,000 worth of Vehicles . You'll want to make your score unrecognizable before you try to sell it off, and that's where Pay 'N' Spray shops come in. Some police heat is nothing a little paint job can't fix. There are also ten Vehicle Challenges to complete.
There are 277 Vehicles in GTA 6, and 281 Standout Vehicles to discover on top of that.
Below you can find a sortable list of Vehicles you can find in GTA 6, with statistics on speed, handling, and more:
Cars now have a visible “ body condition ” meter, which functions similarly to a health bar. You can view this while driving by pressing D-pad Down on the D-pad. Look for the circular meters above the map to check the vehicle’s condition.
Vehicles also now have a gas meter , which you can see beside the body condition meter. You'll need to refuel your vehicle when it gets low on gas by pulling up to a gas pump at a gas station.
If you’re driving an electric vehicle, you’ll have to find yourself a charging station instead, although you’re unlikely to encounter electric vehicles much in the early hours of the game.
There are plenty of ways to repair your vehicle in Leonida (and trust me, you’re going to need ‘em).
You won’t be able to sell cars until you meet Moses Watkins in Chapter 2 . After completing his mission by stealing and retrieving an ’82 Crawler for him, he’ll offer to fence any untracked cars that you bring him. Even better, he gives you a Slim Jim , which you can use to bypass the locks on cars without having to smash the window and trigger an alarm.
Whenever you steal a car, pull up the map and hover over Moses’ shop on the map. You’ll be able to see how much the car will sell for when you bring it into his shop. Alternatively, if you really like the car and want to keep it for yourself, you can also see how much it will cost for you to register the car as your own personal vehicle .
Occasionally you’ll receive texts from Moses asking you to boost specific cars. These usually pay extra and also come with a condition bonus if you manage to bring the car into his garage in good condition. It’s a great and relatively low risk way to make money, especially in Chapter 2.
Once you complete the Daily Driver mission, Moses rewards you with a garage in Port Gellhorn which you can now use to store one more vehicle!
With storage facilities unlocked, you also get the Vice City Real Estate app unlocked for use on your phone, which allows your characters to purchase more garages around Leonida. Each new property varies in cost (starting at $5,000), and each property offers you one more storage location each.

articles.t: GTA 6 PC Port Leak: 209 GB Xbox Dump, No Emulator
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 PC port leak: Cyberleek 209 GB Xbox dump lacks its executable, and no Xbox Series X|S emulator exists. What is verified and what is not.
articles.txt:
Image: Rockstar Games The GTA 6 PC port leak story took a sharper turn on November 21, 2026, two days after the console launch. A leaker calling itself Cyberleek says it put a roughly 209 GB Xbox build of Grand Theft Auto VI into circulation, and XDA Developers reported the claim as an unverified release of a dumped build. Nobody has confirmed the files are real. The reported dump also lacks the main executable, so the game cannot start.
That gap is the whole story. Cyberleek says the community will turn an Xbox build into a PC game within a week, yet reports describe no working Xbox Series X|S emulator that could run it. Our earlier report on the dump covered what appeared on the leaker’s site. This analysis asks a different question: how far is a 209 GB Xbox archive from a playable Windows version, and what do the headlines get right and wrong?
We tie every claim below to a named outlet, and we separate what the reports state from what only the leaker asserts. Rockstar Games has not officially announced a PC port, according to the coverage we reviewed. Everything about a PC route to the game remains speculation for now.

Add Shattered once in the Google app and our stories show up in your news suggestions.
Cyberleek claims to hold a November 2026 build of Grand Theft Auto VI and says it is distributing the archive by torrent. PCMag reported the claim on November 20 and described a download of about 209 GB that the group says contains a decrypted Xbox build. VGTimes added that a link on the group’s site carried a label reading XBOX BUILD 1.0.2.1 (NOV 2026), and that journalists had seen the site itself.
The timing matters. Reports place the post on November 19, the same day the game reached PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. A leak that lands on launch day maximizes attention, and that pattern fits a group that has spent months building an audience around Rockstar’s biggest release.
PCMag also reported that the archive appeared to include files tied to Rockstar’s RAGE engine and Xbox files connected with AMD graphics technology. That detail suggests the listing looks like a real console package, though a convincing file tree proves little by itself. File listings and screenshots are easy to stage, and a name on a folder is not a working game.
Cyberleek also drew a line between this release and a PC release. Its own wording, as quoted by GamesRadar, admitted that this is an Xbox build and not a PC build. We come back to that admission below, because it changes how readers should weigh the PC port framing that dominates search results.
Most of what circulates today is a claim about a claim. Outlets such as PCMag, GameSpot, IGN and Gamereactor UK report that Cyberleek says things, and several note that they could not check the files. The table sorts the main points by how well the coverage supports them.
The pattern is clear. Only two things hold up across outlets: a leaker made public claims, and the reported package cannot launch without a file the leaker withholds. Authenticity sits at the bottom of the confidence scale. The Ma-no.org write-up said Eurogamer could not confirm that the advertised files exist, and The GTA 6 Map reached a similar conclusion in its own coverage.
An executable is the program that loads everything else. Game data, models, audio and scripts sit in archives, and the executable decides how to read them and when to run them. Without it, the 209 GB of reported content is a very large pile of assets with no way to start.
GameSpot reported that the absent executable prevents the build from launching as a playable game. Cyberleek itself describes holding that single file back on a countdown. The group’s framing is that every other file is out and only the launcher is held, a tactic that keeps attention on the story for days.
Assets alone can still interest people. Modelers, datamining communities and analysts can inspect meshes, textures, map files and configuration data if the files are real and readable. That kind of material feeds speculation videos and wiki pages. It does not produce a running game.
A console executable also differs from a Windows one at the instruction and system level. An Xbox title targets a fixed hardware platform and a specific operating environment. articles.chapeau: Débutant, nostalgique, fan de Marvel ou adepte du multijoueur, chaque joueur a ses envies. Amazon vous propose un déstockage PS5 pour contenter tout le monde, sans faire exploser votre budget
articles.txt:
Offrir un cadeau à un joueur, c’est un petit casse-tête. Trop de jeux, trop de modèles, et la crainte de tomber à côté. Pourtant, la bonne idée dépend surtout de la personne en face de vous. Celui qui n’a jamais touché de console n’attend pas la même chose que le fan de comics ou que le copain qui joue en ligne tous les soirs. Avec les fêtes qui approchent, Amazon rassemble justement un déstockage PS5 qui couvre tous ces profils : la console elle-même, deux jeux, une grosse nouveauté et une manette de rechange. Plutôt que de lister des fiches techniques, voici 5 idées classées par type de joueur. Il suffit de reconnaître la personne que vous avez en tête, de choisir la case qui lui correspond et de cliquer. Le budget reste maîtrisé, et le sourire sous le sapin est quasiment garanti.
Pas de disque à glisser dans la machine, avec la PlayStation 5 Édition Numérique, tout passe par le téléchargement. Une fois installés, les jeux démarrent en un éclair. Les images gagnent en finesse et en couleurs, avec la possibilité de jouer en 4K sur une télévision adaptée. Le son est pensé pour entourer le joueur. Elle s’affiche à 799,99 euros et vient avec sa manette DualSense blanche et un socle. Plusieurs ports vous permettent de brancher écran, accessoires et connexion internet.
17,06 euros, c’est le prix d’un ticket pour Los Santos, version PS5 d’occasion. Grand Theft Auto V réunit deux jeux en un. D’un côté, une histoire qui suit un jeune truand, un ancien braqueur et un psychopathe. De l’autre, GTA Online, où jusqu’à 30 joueurs construisent leur réputation. Les parties déjà commencées sur une autre console se retrouvent sur PS5, personnages compris. Au programme : casses à plusieurs, courses, fêtes en penthouse et expositions de voitures. Un jeu à savourer seul ou entre amis.
La guerre éclate en Corée, et le capitaine Price ne reste pas spectateur. À 58,63 euros au lieu de 79,99 euros, Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 se joue en trois temps : une campagne qui passe des tranchées coréennes à New York, Paris et Mumbai, un multijoueur axé sur des duels précis et le mode DMZ, où vous vous infiltrez en territoire ennemi. La boîte vous offre aussi une tenue de soldat, deux camouflages d’arme et 5 heures de double EXP.

Logan a perdu le fil de son passé, et il compte bien le retrouver, griffes en avant. Marvel’s Wolverine, conçu par les créateurs de Marvel’s Spider-Man, est une aventure pour un seul joueur et mise sur l’ambiance sombre et les bagarres nerveuses. L’enquête mène le héros de Madripoor aux paysages gelés du Canada, puis dans les ruelles de Tokyo. Sur sa route, il croise des visages familiers comme Mystique et Oméga Red. Édition physique à 47,94 euros au lieu de 79,99 euros.
Une manette qui se sent autant qu’elle se manie : la DualSense Midnight Black à 59,99 euros fait vibrer chaque situation de jeu, d’une route caillouteuse à l’explosion d’un décor. Ses gâchettes se durcissent ou se relâchent selon l’action, comme pour tendre un arc ou freiner à fond. Un micro est intégré, plus besoin de casque pour parler à ses coéquipiers. 'GTA 6': How to listen to the radio outside of a vehicle
articles.chapeau: Rockstar introduced a fantastic new feature to "GTA 6."
articles.txt:
One of the most important aspects of any Grand Theft Auto game is the soundtrack , and for the first time in the series, GTA 6 doesn't require players to be in a car or near a radio to listen to it.
Rockstar Games went above and beyond licensing dozens of existing bangers across almost any genre you can imagine for GTA 6 's in-game radio stations, and that's before you even get to the fantastic original score from Justice. However, one small limitation of previous games in the series was that you couldn't really enjoy all of that music while walking around.
Thankfully, Rockstar Games took a cue from how people listen to music in 2026. Here is how to listen to music in GTA 6 without driving a car.
In real life, most people have a pair of headphones or earbuds handy so they can listen to music on their phones. GTA 6 joins some other open-world action games like Watch Dogs 2 in allowing players to use virtual headphones to jam out to some tunes from a smart device while simply walking around the world. The best part is that you can do this from a very early point in the game, though it will require a little bit of in-game money.
Protagonist Jason Duval is perhaps the only guy in Leonida who doesn't own headphones of any kind at the start of GTA 6 , so you'll have to go buy some. This can be done at any electronics store in Vice City and the surrounding areas, and you'll know a store sells headphones if the store's icon on the in-game map is a pair of headphones. Convenient!
Unless you really branch out right away and decide to explore the whole map before getting on with the story, the easiest way to get headphones at the start is to drive up north from Jason's neighborhood to the town of Hamlet. Some of the early main story missions will take you there, anyway. What you're looking for is a store called Zeke's Electronics on the north side of Hamlet.
Simply go in and you'll be able to buy either over-ear headphones or earbuds next to the cash register. Over-ear cans will run you about $200, while earbuds cost $119. I can't tell if there's a meaningful difference between the two aside from looks, so just go with whatever you like more.
Once you have your headphones, simply hold left on the D-pad to listen to the radio while outside of a car. I recommend the Dirty South Classics station, personally, but your mileage may vary. Recommended deals for you HBO Max — top pick for premium content
Alex Perry is a tech reporter at Mashable who primarily covers video games and consumer tech. Alex has spent most of the last decade reviewing games, smartphones, headphones, and laptops, and he doesn’t plan on stopping anytime soon. He is also a Pisces, a cat lover, and a Kansas City sports fan. Alex can be found on Bluesky at yelix.bsky.social .

articles.chapeau: Vous l'attendiez depuis des années et GTA 6 est de nouveau disponible. Leclerc propose le jeu au meilleur prix du web, de quoi vous éviter de courir après les stocks et de guetter chaque réapprovisionnement
articles.txt:
Le jeu Grand Theft Auto VI plonge les joueurs dans la région la plus ensoleillée d'Amérique. L'intrigue suit Jason et Lucia, deux héros à qui la vie ne fait pas de cadeau, obligés de compter l'un sur l'autre au cœur d'un complot criminel qui s'étend dans tout l'État de Leonida. Le mode solo laisse chaque joueur avancer à son propre rythme dans les rues de Vice City, sans partenaire à coordonner ni équipe à rejoindre. Par ailleurs, la boîte officielle contient exclusivement un code d'activation numérique et aucun disque : le jeu se télécharge directement sur la console PS5, sans rien à insérer. Enfin, le code ne s'active qu'avec un compte PlayStation enregistré en France ou dans l'un des pays listés par l'éditeur, une condition à vérifier avant l'achat. Le jeu Grand Theft Auto VI est disponible au prix de 60 euros sur Leclerc.
Le Black Friday Samsung démarre très fort : les meilleures offres
La classification PEGI 18 ans et plus attribuée à Grand Theft Auto VI, un repère européen d'âge conseillé, signale un jeu réservé aux adultes. Les parents repèrent ainsi d'un coup d'œil que ce titre ne convient pas aux plus jeunes. L'univers de Grand Theft Auto VI reste entièrement fictif, ses personnages, lieux et situations étant imaginaires, le joueur y entre comme dans un film, sans lien avec des personnes ou des lieux réels. L'éditeur précise que les comportements représentés dans le jeu ne sont ni approuvés ni encouragés par Rockstar. Le genre Action met la manette au centre de l'expérience, puisque le joueur agit et réagit au fil des scènes plutôt que de rester spectateur.
De plus, certaines fonctions du jeu demandent une connexion à Internet, un compte Rockstar Games ou un code à usage unique, et leur disponibilité peut varier d'un joueur à l'autre.

articles.t: Émulateur GTA 6 sur PC : état réel (KytyPS5) et faux virus
articles.chapeau: Peut-on émuler GTA 6 sur PC avec KytyPS5 ou shadPS4 ? Verrou du firmware 14.23 PS5, moteur RAGE 9 et liste noire des faux émulateurs virus PCSX5 et RPCS5.
articles.txt:
Suivi GTA 6 sur PC en direct • 21 novembre 2026 (Point de 07h00, heure de Paris)
Où en est-on à cette heure ? GTA 6 ( PPSA01547 ) n’est pas encore lancé sur PC à cet instant précis uniquement parce que son exécutable eboot.bin attend son dump déchiffré sous le firmware 14.23 . Mais en coulisses, dopés par l’automatisation et l’IA, les développeurs de KytyPS5 , AnyPS5 et SharpEmu ont déjà assemblé toutes les briques du moteur RAGE pour être prêts à la minute où le verrou saute :
Ce matin (21 nov. à 07h00) • Le « GTA Renderer », le décodeur Kraken PS5 et les patchs RAGE sont déjà prêts
Vont-ils y arriver et quand ? • Pourquoi tout peut basculer du jour au lendemain
Vigilance absolue en attendant le vrai dump • Attention aux faux fichiers
Mise à jour en direct (21 novembre 2026) : Non, aucun émulateur PlayStation 5 ni Xbox Series X|S ne permet d’exécuter nativement Grand Theft Auto VI sur PC en ce 21 novembre 2026. Si vous croisez sur YouTube, TikTok ou Discord une vidéo promettant de lancer Vice City à 60 FPS sur ordinateur dès aujourd’hui grâce à un installateur ou un émulateur clé en main, il s’agit systématiquement d’un piège destiné à infecter votre machine. En revanche, une méthode réseau 100 % légitime (via Chiaki-ng , PXPlay ou Remote Play à partir d’une console) permet bel et bien d’afficher et de jouer à GTA 6 sur votre écran PC dès aujourd’hui.
Sur le plan purement cryptographique, une confusion majeure a alimenté toutes les rumeurs de la semaine. Les 210 Go d’archives PlayGo (fichiers .pkg découpés en 32 segments) issus du préchargement sur les serveurs de Sony ont effectivement circulé en ligne avant l’ouverture officielle. Toutefois, une archive .pkg brute reste une coquille illisible sans sa clé de déchiffrement finale.
À la suite de l’alerte déclenchée par le chercheur en sécurité Gezine sur le firmware 14.22, Sony Interactive Entertainment a verrouillé le lancement mondial en rendant obligatoire la mise à jour système firmware 14.23 . Ce micrologiciel 14.23 conditionne la délivrance de la clé de déchiffrement AES finale via le PlayStation Network au moment du premier démarrage. Sans exécutable binaire ( eboot.bin ) déchiffré, aucun émulateur sur PC ne peut lire ni interpréter la moindre ligne de code de GTA 6 .
Au-delà de ce blindage logiciel, le défi matériel est tout aussi colossal. Le moteur RAGE 9 de Rockstar Games s’appuie massivement sur l’accélération matérielle du Ray-Tracing (structures BVH dédiées à l’illumination globale et aux reflets) ainsi que sur un pipeline de streaming SSD DirectStorage associé au décompresseur matériel Kraken . Cette charge met déjà les consoles de salon à rude épreuve, comme le confirment les premiers retours des joueurs sur GTA 6 à Vice City , et dépasse largement les capacités de traduction à la volée des émulateurs PC actuels.
Pour distinguer le travail scientifique légitime des escroqueries, voici l’état réel et vérifié des véritables émulateurs PlayStation et Xbox open-source face à Grand Theft Auto VI en ce 21 novembre 2026 :
Depuis l’aube en ce 21 novembre 2026, plusieurs séquences partagées sur les réseaux sociaux prétendent montrer Grand Theft Auto VI atteindre son écran titre sur ordinateur avant de geler. En croisant l’historique des commits et les journaux d’exécution des dépôts open-source, on constate que cette rumeur amalgame en réalité trois faits distincts survenus au cours de la nuit.
Le premier événement repose sur une véritable percée logicielle autour du stade « Boot & Menu » sur PC, portée par GitHub AnyPS5 et par KytyPS5 . Contrairement à l’émulation classique pratiquée par KytyPS5 ou SharpEmu , qui traduit les instructions de la console à la volée, AnyPS5 fonctionne comme un recompilateur statique : il relie directement l’exécutable PS5 aux bibliothèques système prx réimplémentées nativement sous Windows (44,65 % couvertes à ce jour) et recompile l’intégralité des shaders RDNA 2 gfx1013 en SPIR-V . Si des menus et des introductions de jeux natifs PS5 tournent effectivement sur PC aujourd’hui, il s’agit du stade Menus atteint par AnyPS5 sur l’édition PS5 de GTA V ( PPSA03420 ) ainsi que du stade Boots franchi par KytyPS5 (build 2026-11-15-f9dd415 ) sur des exclusivités récentes comme Ghost of Yōtei ( PPSA26344 , qui compile 108 programmes de shaders et affiche les logos Sony et Sucker Punch sur un Ryzen 7 7800X3D couplé à une RTX 3080 Ti avant de figer juste avant le menu principal) ou Astro Bot ( PPSA21567 ).

“GTA VI” permet aux femmes d’être aussi dures et ravagées que les hommes
articles.chapeau: Non content d’être le jeu vidéo le plus fourmillant de détails de l’histoire du médium, “Grand Theft Auto VI”, sorti ce 19 novembre, recèle bien des surprises. ...
articles.txt:
Lucia Caminos et Jason Duval sont bien plus que les deux personnages jouables de “Grand Theft Auto VI” : ils forment un couple réaliste et attachant. Photo Rockstar Games Dans Grand Theft Auto VI [GTA VI], les studios Rockstar ont créé un monde virtuel extraordinaire, d’une richesse éblouissante de détails, du jamais-vu dans le jeu vidéo. En faire un compte rendu est d’ailleurs compliqué, un peu comme si j’essayais de vous résumer Paris. Il est possible d’y vivre tellement de choses que je ne sais pas par où commencer.
Si vous aviez pu m’espionner ces dernières semaines, quand j’ai découvert le nouveau GTA [en avant-première, avant sa sortie sur PlayStation 5 et Xbox Series X et S], vous m’auriez vu braquer des banques, mettre le feu à une ferme de cannabis ou foncer à toute allure sur l’autoroute au coucher du soleil en écoutant du Bad Bunny à plein volume, mais vous m’auriez aussi vu faire des squats à la salle, m’acheter des fringues, monter une table basse ou marcher le long de la plage en dégustant une glace.
Il y a une telle profusion de choses à faire qu’il est difficile de définir précisément à quelle catégorie appartient ce jeu. Est-ce un film de gangsters interactif ? Une simulation urbaine ? Un jeu de bagnoles ? Une version maousse des Sims avec des professionnels du crime à la place des personnages dont vous devez prendre soin ? Chaque joueur vivra le jeu différemment, et c’est toute la beauté de GTA VI.

articles.t: Cyberleak's leaked GTA 6 build runs into a wall: there is no Xbox Series X|S emulator - Gamereactor
articles.chapeau: Cyberleak says it is torrenting a full Xbox build of Grand Theft Auto VI and that PC players could emulate it within a week, but no working Xbox Series X|S emulator exists.
articles.txt:
The hacking group Cyberleak says it is distributing a full November 2026 Xbox build of Grand Theft Auto VI by torrent and claims that PC players could have the game "emulated inside a week" , a promise that runs straight into a technical wall: no working Xbox Series X|S emulator exists.
Cyberleak said in a 19 November post that it holds the full Xbox build and that the files were going out by torrent immediately. Early looks at the release from members of the hacking community suggest it is genuine but missing the launcher .EXE file needed to run it, and Cyberleak says that executable is "held on a countdown" until 23 November unless its crypto token reaches a $15 million market cap first .
The malware archive vx-underground, which inspected the torrent, says the files contain actual GTA 6 assets and that people could be playing on PC by Monday if the .exe drops on the 23rd as promised.
> wake up > take a shit > get out of bed > check beep boop > over 9000 DMs > "SCHMEELI, GTA VI LEAK" > ??? > sends link > torrent > ok > look inside > actual assets > huh > squint eyes > look closer > not larp huh, how about that. the cyberleek guy released the full xbox gta 6… pic.twitter.com/1MDrGI97Dy
The week-long timeline is Cyberleak's own claim, and it deserves scepticism for two reasons. First, the group has a documented history of using previous GTA 6 leaks to pump a $250,000 cryptocurrency scheme, so its stated dates are best treated as claims rather than scheduled events.
Second, and more fundamentally, emulation may be the wrong word for what would follow an executable release. No working Xbox Series X|S emulators yet exist, so there is no ready-made route from a dumped Xbox build to a playable PC version. A working unofficial port would instead depend on recompilation, converting the console code to run natively on PC, a far slower and less certain path than the frame rates Cyberleak touts.
GTA 6 launched on console on 19 November, and Rockstar has not announced a PC version at all. Rumours point to an official port in early 2027, and former Rockstar technical director Obbe Vermeij has argued the studio would benefit from releasing a PC port early given the rise of AI-assisted ports. articles.txt:
GTA 6 , the highest-rated game of all-time , is getting review bombed on Metacritic as idiots attempt to plunge the seminal Rockstar release’s rating with bogus ‘0’ scores.
At the time of writing, the title has a user score of 5.4 , meaning it’s considered ‘Mixed or Average’:
This is in sharp contrast to critics, who awarded the game an average score of 99, making it the best-reviewed title of all time.
“Good thing Rockstar doesn’t blacklist user ratings like they do critics,” one review reads.
There’s a theory among some online that the dev blacklists media outlets for giving its games poor scores, but it put GTA 6 in the hands of more than 150 critics, so I don’t buy that for a single second.
Many of the ‘0’ reviews all touch on the same thing: 30fps is “unplayable”, the series has gone “woke”, and the “story is horrible”. (“I never smiled one time,” writes one seemingly perpetually miserable user.)
There are some legitimate criticisms among these; one person writes they’re not a fan of the life sim elements and prefer the “power fantasy” of older games. That’s fair, but it doesn’t make it a ‘0’.
Metacritic reviews have always been a disaster really, because you don’t need to actually own a game to rate it. Many of the best titles ever released have dreadful user scores on the site.
On the PS Store , though – where you actually have to spend money on the game to score it – the current rating sits at 4.84 based on 170k reviews. So that’s probably a better reflection of how the community feels.
My take on all this is that humans are predictable creatures: wherever there’s something popular, you’re probably going to find a group of people eager to tear it down.

articles.txt:
PC players are still waiting for GTA 6, but a leaker claims that could change within days. The prediction follows the release of files described as an Xbox build of Rockstar’s game.
There is a large gap between that claim and a playable PC version. The main executable is reportedly missing, and we have not seen independent proof that the leaked material runs as a complete game on a computer. Rockstar has not announced a PC release date.
Cyberleek, the name behind earlier GTA 6 leaks, says the community could have the game running on PC within a week once the missing file is available. That is the leaker’s prediction, not a timetable from Rockstar or a demonstrated result.
GTA 6 is available on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S. Image: Rockstar Games
PC Gamer reports that Cyberleek claims to have released a November Xbox build while withholding the executable. The leaker has tied the file’s release to a cryptocurrency promotion and has also claimed it will be released on November 23.
The reported leak is described as an Xbox build, not an official PC release. Image: Rockstar Games
Security research group vx-underground says it examined the files and found game assets. It also speculated about PC play if the missing executable appears. That is still conditional, and it does not show that an unofficial PC build is ready.
Another developer, OptiJuegos , noted that the game uses Microsoft’s Game Development Kit and shares architecture with Windows. The observation may explain some of the optimism, but shared technology alone does not establish that a console build will work on a PC.
Rockstar has not confirmed when the game will arrive on PC. Image: Rockstar Games
Even if the missing file appears, people working on an unofficial version would still have to make it run. Compatibility, performance and stability would be open questions, and Cyberleek’s claims about timing or frame rate should not be treated as verified results.
There is also a security reason to be cautious. NordVPN’s researchers warn that scammers are using fake GTA 6 PC downloads as bait. Do not enter account details or run an unfamiliar installer simply because it promises early access.
For now, the supported ways to play are PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S. Amazon sells a boxed PS5 edition , but it contains a download code rather than a disc. The listing says the code requires a US or Canadian PlayStation account; it is not a PC copy.
If you are waiting for an official PC release, I would watch Rockstar’s announcements before making plans around any date. A leaker’s confidence is not the same as a working release.

articles.txt:
Hacker group Cyberleak says it holds a full November 2026 Xbox build of Grand Theft Auto VI and is distributing it by torrent, with the launcher executable withheld until 23 November, a date it says it will meet regardless of any other condition.
That is the claim, and it needs the hedge it deserves. Early looks at the build from people in the hacking community, and an inspection by the security account vx-underground, suggest the files are genuine GTA 6 assets. Both describe the same gap: the main .EXE needed to actually run the build is missing, the same thing Rockstar’s own preload files drew dataminers to this week. Cyberleak says it will release that executable on 23 November whatever happens, and that the community would then have the Xbox build running on PC within a week. It also says early release can be bought: its crypto token reaching a US$15 million market cap.

Cyberleak has done this before. The same group used earlier GTA 6 leaks to promote a cryptocurrency scheme worth US$250,000, which makes the token market-cap condition look less like a countdown clock and more like a promotion. Treat the US$15 million figure and the 23 November date as claims by a group with a documented history of monetising leaks, not as scheduled events. What the token is, and whether the market-cap figure can be checked, is not established.
Even the group’s own framing undercuts the promise. Cyberleak calls itself a consumer advocate, telling players not to preorder, but its demands are all about its own token. A real motive of that kind does not usually announce a hard date for free delivery.
The bigger technical claim deserves its own scepticism. No usable Xbox Series X|S emulators exist yet, so the group’s “emulated inside a week, running far past 30fps” line runs into a wall it does not mention. A working PC version would more likely depend on someone recompiling the dumped console code, a far harder job than Cyberleak’s post suggests. If the Xbox path stalls, the group says it will go after a PS5 build.
For Australian PC players, the practical position has not changed. Grand Theft Auto VI is out on consoles, and Rockstar has not announced a PC version at all. Rumours point to an official PC port early in 2027, but that is rumour only, and nothing has been said about an Australian price or timing. Former Rockstar technical director Obbe Vermeij has argued publicly that the company should release a PC port early, given the rise of AI-assisted ports, a view that has gained attention as console-to-PC gaps get tested from the outside.
Rockstar has made no statement on the leak, and it is known to pursue people who leak its games. The next dated step is Cyberleak’s own: 23 November, the day it says the executable drops.

articles.t: Here Are Some Super Useful Control Shortcuts GTA 6 Doesn't Tell You About
articles.chapeau: Did you know you can turn your radio on and off without using a submenu?
articles.txt:
I’ve played over 150 hours of Grand Theft Auto 6 . You might think I’ve seen it all, and that I know everything there is to know about the game. Nope! I’m still discovering new mechanics, features, and open-world moments after all this time. This includes some very handy control shortcuts I recently learned about that will make your life in Vice City a little easier.
First off, let’s start with the whole reason I wanted to write this blog. Did you know that you can quickly toggle your car radio on and off without having to enter a submenu? All you have to do is double-tap left on the D-pad, and Jason or Lucia will turn the radio on or off.
I had no idea you could do this until I saw people sharing it on Reddit. The game doesn’t explain this shortcut, as far as I can tell. I couldn’t even find it mentioned in the in-game help menu, which does include lots of other nifty tips and tricks.
Here’s another trick I just learned about: You can double-tap the circle/B button while in a car to cycle the headlights between off, high beams, and low beams.
I thought you had to hold left on the D-pad to open up the vehicle submenu to turn off the headlights, but nope! And again, this isn’t mentioned in the help menu and if a prompt appeared during the normal course of the game to explain this, I and many others must have missed it.
Here’s another useful thing you can do inside cars: If you double-tap the triangle/Y button while driving, you’ll exit the vehicle without turning off the engine or radio.
GTA 6 ‘s help menu does call this out and mentions you can do this at speed to have your car drive into something while you roll out the side to safely. But again, I can’t remember a single time when the game forced me to do this or taught me that it was possible. I learned from a random post online. I guess I should have dug through the help menu more, but come on, who is doing that in Grand Theft Auto ?
Another feature mentioned in the help menu that I just learned about is the ability to click the right stick in and yell at nearby drivers. Rockstar refers to this as the road rage button, and it’s a good thing to have in a game where NPC drivers, inspired by real Floridian drivers, suck shit and drive like maniacs.
One more useful control trick: You can double-tap the triangle/Y button while driving a boat to get up and walk around the deck while the boat keeps on cruising.
The next time I boot up GTA 6, I’m going to start double-tapping random buttons during different parts of the game to see what other hidden shortcuts and control options Rockstar has buried in this massive game. And if you want some more useful hidden features, check out this blog about how to flip cars and sit anywhere you want in GTA 6.

articles.t: So Is The $100 GTA 6 Ultimate Edition Actually Worth It?
articles.chapeau: It really comes down to how many extra shirts, tattoo designs, and car options you want
articles.txt:
Before Grand Theft Auto 6 even launched , there was some controversy online over the announcement of a $100 “Ultimate Edition” version of the game that would include access to a few exclusive shops and in-game cosmetics. So, now that GTA 6 is here and I’ve spent over 150 hours with it, I can share what’s in the Ultimate Edition, how you access this stuff, and if it’s worth upgrading from the standard $80 version of GTA 6 . The short version is…eh, probably not.
In GTA 6, there are five stores that are locked behind the Ultimate Edition paywall. These stores include an exclusive tattoo parlor, street clothing shop, and hair salon. Now, at first, I thought it was pretty shitty of Rockstar to hide stores behind a paywall. And to be clear, it still does suck that a few shops are only accessible if you pay $20 more. But after playing GTA 6 , I discovered that the world is filled with over 600 stores. There are already so many clothing, car, hair, make-up, and nail options in the base game. So the Ultimate Edition’s extra few stores don’t feel that necessary. And after actually visiting these shops and seeing what they have to offer, I don’t think people are missing out on that much.
First up, there’s 305, a clothing store specializing in urban, skater-inspired clothing and gear. There’s some alright stuff in here, including some nice-looking jeans for Jason and a cool graphic shirt or two. And a really wild fuzzy hat for Lucia. But the options in here aren’t something you need to have. You can create plenty of great and cool outfits without stopping by this Ultimate Edition–only retailer.
Next up is the tattoo shop Electric Fang. Of all the Ultimate Edition stores, this is the coolest one to enter. And I do think some of Electric Fang’s tat designs are solid. But again, there are so many other options in the game for ink that I’m not sure these are very necessary or worth the $20 upgrade.
Sara’s Unisex Salon might be the best of the bunch as it offers some stylish hairdos for both Jason and Lucia. But on top of that, it offers some really nice makeup options for Lucia and cool nail art, too. I ended up using some of these options during my time as Lucia because I liked them so much. Still, again, there are so many other good options for haircuts and nail art already in GTA 6 that I’m not sure you need to spend $20 more on this version.
There are also two exclusive car mod garages in GTA 6 ‘s Ultimate Edition. One of them, Rideout Customs, offers some really gaudy and exotic paint and accessories options. If you wanted a neon-pink car with stripes painted to look like cheetah print, well, this is the place for you.
The other mod shop, One-Eyed Willie’s, is more useful. It offers up some really nice off-road options. There aren’t nearly as many off-road modding options in GTA 6 as there are for street cars, so losing out on access to this in the base game is a shame. I also love that One-Eyed Willie’s offers up a random paint job for every car in the game, including non-off-road vehicles, that you can only see once it’s applied. I brought my Banshee into the shop, and it received this pretty pink design that I loved.
The Ultimate Edition also includes some unique free clothing items based on characters from an in-universe cartoon you can watch. These clothes are fine. I guess if you like the show a lot, they might be fun to wear. But…eh.
Beyond the stores and cosmetics, there are some exclusive vehicles you get access to in the Ultimate Edition, but some of these are only available during chapter one for story reasons. The only thing from the Ultimate Edition I used regularly and still use often when I play is the Vapid off-road truck. It’s fast as heck, a great option for driving on the dirt, and can be upgraded into a beast that can hold a lot of stolen loot. There’s also a classic car scavenger hunt side mission hidden behind the paywall, but after 150 hours I’ve barely interacted with that thing.
Answering the big question of “Is the Ultimate Edition worth it?” is tricky, because it depends entirely on what you value and your taste for fashion and cosmetics. I’ve provided some samples of what’s on offer and how it fits into the larger GTA 6 world.
My opinion is that if you can afford the extra $20, a few bits of the Ultimate Edition are nice and worth the upgrade. But for the most part, if you just want to play Grand Theft Auto 6 to enjoy the open world and its story, you don’t need this upgrade. You’ll have a great tim

articles.t: Why you shouldn't depend on GTA 6 to auto-save - Engadget
articles.chapeau: We explain how GTA 6's auto-save system works, so you don't accidentally lose progress in the massive game.
articles.txt:
Thomas Pajot/Shutterstock Add Engadget on Google: Preferred Source Google Discover In addition to getting your boss to let you take time off to play Grand Theft Auto 6 , one of the more frightening prospects of playing games like GTA 6 is trusting the auto-save feature. It's been part of so many games for literal decades, but it's really found its home in big, expansive open-world games like the GTA series. The old mantra of auto-save, then manual save twice just to be sure, still rings true today.
As ever, depending on auto save to make sure your journey through Vice City is like depending on Rockstar to release something quickly. It's not a tremendously wise idea, and with GTA 6 , Rockstar has implemented an auto save that certainly functions, but maybe not in the same way you may have grown accustomed to in other games.
If you're already tens of hours deep in your journey through the criminal underworld , it may be wise to stick around for a moment. Here's what we know about how the saving system works, and what you can do to make sure your progress isn't lost.
Vardanyan Karen/Shutterstock Grand Theft Auto 6' s auto-save feature may not work as you think. Instead of automatically saving at regular intervals, the game appears to save after every main mission, as well as after some major side missions, expensive purchases, or when you get killed or arrested. That means if you're roaming the map , getting into trouble or driving around, the game relies on you to save manually. Unfortunately, the auto-save icon (a white spinning circle) doesn't always show up when the game saves.
GTA 6 has one auto-save slot, which it overwrites each time, and 15 manual slots. To manually save, press the Options button on PS5 or the Menu button on Xbox , then go to the Game tab and choose Save Game.
The unusual auto-save system has caused several people to lose hours of progress, although in the bigger picture of a game that's sold in the millions, it's thankfully not too widespread. One save tip from our editors playing through the game: GTA 6 doesn't auto-save in the middle of a mission, period.
If you're cruising the streets of Vice City and worry about a power outage, or if you're someone who turns the console off without thinking, remember to save manually. The same goes when you strike it big and get your hands on the ride of your dreams or clear one of the countless side missions: Save regularly to keep your GTA 6 journey going and your sanity intact.

articles.txt:
An advertisement for Grand Theft Auto VI is displayed in New York’s Times Square. Photograph: Bloomberg/Getty Images Grand Theft Auto VI appears to mock NFL sexual misconduct scandals in radio parody Comedian Stavros Halkias voices fictional shock jock
The long-awaited Grand Theft Auto VI appears to have taken aim at the NFL’s sexual misconduct scandals – and the culture of excuses surrounding them – with a satirical segment on the video game’s fictional conservative talk radio station bearing striking similarities to allegations against Cleveland Browns quarterback Deshaun Watson and Kansas City Chiefs kicker Justin Tucker.
The segment features comedian and voice actor Stavros Halkias defending Anthony Ross, a fictional player for the Vice City Manatees, after an “alleged” incident involving a team masseuse. Although neither Watson nor Tucker are mentioned by name, the circumstances closely resemble allegations made against both players.
Halkias, voicing outspoken sports talk radio host Dominick “The Brick” Brizzolato in a withering caricature of right-wing media bombast, argues the player was not responsible for becoming sexually aroused during a massage and instead blames the therapist, in an apparent parody of the defenses offered on behalf of athletes accused of sexual misconduct.
Read more “Be the voice of reason here,” Halkias begins. “You know, there is extreme idiocy and stupidity on both sides, folks. I mean, think. Put yourself in Ross’s shoes. OK, you’re a pro football player, a warrior in a proud tribe called the Vice City Manatees. You’re getting treated by the team masseuse after a rough game, after leaving it all out on the field. GTA 6 was released on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X/S, but PC players are still waiting to join in the fun. Rockstar has yet to announce an official PC release date, although recent reports suggest the game could arrive on the platform in early 2027 . However, it now seems that PC players might get a chance to experience the game much sooner, thanks to a major leak.

Cyberleek, the notorious leaker who shared several GTA 6 videos and other content before the game’s release, has reportedly leaked a nearly complete Xbox build of the game. The files are now circulating online, and some members of the modding community believe they could make GTA 6 playable on PC within a week.
Cyberleek has returned and released the Xbox GTA 6 build. He claims the final file, which is required to make it readable will be released on November 23rd or immediately if his coin reaches 15M in marketcap. pic.twitter.com/uG6y6cKjTR
The leaked build is reportedly around 209GB in size and contains files from a November 2026 version of the game. While the files have not been independently verified in full, cybersecurity group VX Underground has examined the leak and suggested that it appears genuine.
However, there’s one major problem. The leaked files are missing the game’s main executable, which is essential for running it. Cyberleek claims to have deliberately withheld this file and is using it to promote a cryptocurrency.
According to the leaker, the executable will be released immediately if their cryptocurrency reaches a market capitalization of $15 million. Even if that target isn’t met, Cyberleek has promised to release the file on November 23.
Interestingly, Cyberleek is confident that the community will manage to get GTA 6 running on PC within a week of the leak. The leaker also believes that the unofficial version could achieve frame rates well above 30 FPS, which is the target on current-generation consoles.
VX Underground has also suggested that a playable PC version could become possible as early as November 23, provided the missing executable is released. However, this should be taken with a grain of salt, and there’s no guarantee that the leaked files can be turned into a working PC version so quickly.
For those unfamiliar with Cyberleek, this isn’t the first time the leaker has targeted Rockstar. Earlier this year, Cyberleek shared several pieces of alleged GTA 6 gameplay footage before the game’s official launch. Some of those clips showed previously unseen activities and gameplay moments, while others appeared to come from an unfinished development build.

articles.chapeau: Retrouvez tous les codes des coffres-forts de GTA 6, leurs emplacements dans Leonida et les solutions pour les ouvrir facilement.
articles.txt:
À Vice City, les plus belles fortunes ne dorment pas toujours dans les banques. Derrière le comptoir d’un commerce, au fond d’un motel abandonné ou dans les locaux d’un gang, il suffit parfois de pousser la bonne porte pour tomber sur un coffre bien rempli. Mais dans GTA 6, mettre la main sur un butin ne signifie pas forcément pouvoir repartir avec. Certains coffres-forts exigent une combinaison précise, tandis que d’autres demandent un peu d’observation pour découvrir les indices laissés dans les environs.
Au fil de leur aventure à travers Leonida, Lucia et Jason auront ainsi de nombreuses occasions de récupérer de l’argent, des bijoux et quelques objets particulièrement rares. Pour vous éviter de fouiller chaque bâtiment pendant de longues minutes, nous avons rassemblé tous les codes des coffres-forts de GTA 6 actuellement connus , avec leurs emplacements et les différentes méthodes permettant de les ouvrir. Nous avons également inclus les combinaisons des portes verrouillées qui donnent accès à des véhicules ou à des équipements cachés.
Les coffres-forts se trouvent principalement dans les repaires de gangs, les commerces et certains bâtiments liés aux missions principales. La plupart utilisent des combinaisons à quatre chiffres, même si quelques secrets demandent des codes plus longs.
Depuis la sortie du jeu, les joueurs ont déjà découvert plusieurs dizaines de lieux contenant des coffres. Tous ne possèdent toutefois pas une combinaison fixe, notamment lors des braquages que vous pouvez répéter librement.
Voici les 21 emplacements pour lesquels une combinaison a été signalée :
Les codes suivis d’un astérisque demandent encore confirmation.
D’autres combinaisons ont également été signalées, notamment 3718 pour une cachette située dans un hangar de Sundown Private Airfield . Son association exacte avec le coffre reste cependant insuffisamment documentée pour l’ajouter à la liste principale.
Ces informations concernent les combinaisons découvertes jusqu’à présent. Certains repaires peuvent utiliser un code différent selon la partie, tandis que les coffres des braquages ordinaires peuvent changer de combinaison à chaque nouvelle tentative.
Si vous souhaitez récupérer rapidement quelques milliers de dollars, Port Gellhorn est clairement l’une des régions les plus intéressantes à explorer dès le deuxième chapitre.
Cette ville abrite plusieurs établissements utilisés par Kolt & Associates pour leurs opérations clandestines. Trois d’entre eux possèdent des coffres accessibles pendant vos activités criminelles, avec un avantage appréciable : leurs combinaisons sont regroupées au même endroit.
Le chantier naval de Brooks Boatworks se trouve au nord-est de Port Gellhorn, non loin du Pay ‘n’ Spray. Plusieurs membres de Kolt & Associates occupent les lieux et protègent un butin dissimulé dans l’un des bâtiments.
Pour accéder au coffre, vous devrez pénétrer dans l’enceinte du chantier, notamment par une ouverture dans le grillage, puis rejoindre l’étage de l’entrepôt principal.
Mais le véritable intérêt de ce lieu se trouve dans un autre bâtiment situé à l’est du chantier. Une carte accrochée au mur indique les combinaisons de trois opérations du gang :
En examinant cette carte, vous pourrez enregistrer ces informations et préparer vos prochaines visites. C’est donc un excellent premier arrêt si vous souhaitez enchaîner plusieurs cambriolages dans les environs.
Le bowling abandonné de Port Gellhorn cache lui aussi un coffre intéressant, protégé par des membres de Kolt & Associates.
Après avoir éliminé les occupants, traversez l’établissement jusqu’au fond des pistes. Derrière le comptoir réservé au personnel, un passage mène à un petit bureau où se trouve le coffre-fort.
Entrez la combinaison 0300 pour récupérer son contenu , qui peut représenter plusieurs milliers de dollars.
Profitez également de votre présence dans le bâtiment pour examiner les équipements abandonnés par le gang. Vous pourrez notamment y récupérer le Gutterball Moreland 850, une variante unique de fusil à pompe.
Cette découverte peut vous éviter un passage coûteux chez Ammu-Nation. Nous avons d’ailleurs consacré un guide aux meilleures armes à trouver dès le début de GTA 6 , avec plusieurs emplacements accessibles pendant les premiers chapitres.
Le troisième établissement à visiter est La Cascara Motel, situé à l’ouest de Port Gellhorn, dans les environs de Wild Hog Point.
L’ancien motel sert de repaire au même gang et possède plusieurs pièces accessibles.

Now that GTA 6 is out and in players' hands, you might not think there would be much left to leak, but the group or individual behind the vegetarian pseudonym is now in the process of releasing an Xbox build of the game. That build could, Cyberleek threatens, turn into a PC version of GTA 6 in a matter of days.
"CL holds the full November 2026 build of Grand Theft Auto VI, and it is going out by torrent," Cyberleek says in a November 19 post captured by our friends at PC Gamer . "Now."
It's a typically dramatic message from the leaker, but early looks at the build from members of the hacking community suggest that the release is legit. It's just missing the main .EXE file needed to make it all go.
That executable is being "held on a countdown," Cyberleek claims. "Honest terms, as always: it is an Xbox build this time, not a PC build. CL does not care. This community will have it emulated inside a week, running far past 30fps. CL told you not to preorder for a reason. This is one of the reasons."
"Emulated" might be the wrong word, as no robust Xbox Series X/S emulators yet exist. But with recent advances in AI coding, getting console games playable on PC is starting to look downright trivial. Once a console game's been dumped, there's been little to stop a recompilation-based PC version from following, as we've seen with Nintendo's The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake .
In technical terms, of course, GTA 6 is a substantial leap over the Ocarina of Time remake, and recompilation devs might have a harder time getting a game driven by a massive open world and ray traced lighting running on PC at a playable frame rate. Regardless, once a pirated build is out there, an unofficial PC port is likely just a matter of time.
Rumors suggest that Rockstar plans to release an official GTA 6 PC port early in 2027 , but the company hasn't even officially announced that the port will happen yet. Former Rockstar technical director Obbe Vermeij reckons that it'd be in the company's benefit to release a PC port early given the rise of AI ports , and the studio's hand might be forced sooner rather than later.
Weekly digests, tales from the communities you love, and more
There's reason to be skeptical of Cyberleek's claims since this is, after all, the same hacker who used the previous leaks as a way to pump up a $250,000 cryptocurrency grift . And yes, the crypto scam continues – Cyberleek says it'll release the executable early if its token reaches a $15 million market cap.
Still, Cyberleek says it'll make good on the release of the Xbox executable on November 23, regardless of the outcome of the crypto scheme. If that doesn't lead to a PC port, "CL will work to get a PS5 build." A bold sense of dedication at a time when other GTA leakers are becoming well aware of Rockstar's willingness to track them to the ends of the earth .

articles.chapeau: « GTA 6 » a rapporté 3,79 milliards de dollars en 24 heures, a annoncé Rockstar Games vendredi. Le jeu avait déjà enregistré 32,5 millions de précommandes avant sa sortie
articles.txt:
Avant sa sortie jeudi à minuit, GTA 6 avait déjà enregistré 32,5 millions de précommandes, selon Rockstar Games. Vendredi, l’éditeur a annoncé que les ventes du jeu vidéo , proposé entre 80 et 100 euros selon les versions, avaient atteint 3,79 milliards de dollars en 24 heures. Le studio qualifie ce lancement de « record ».
En une journée, Grand Theft Auto 6 a généré près de cinq fois le montant des ventes de son prédécesseur sur la même durée. En 2013, GTA 5 avait rapporté environ 800 millions de dollars lors de ses premières 24 heures. Les ventes de GTA 6 au premier jour dépassent aussi les recettes mondiales du film Avengers : Endgame , qui s’élèvent à environ 2,9 milliards de dollars. Son prédecesseur, GTA 5 , s'est écoulé à 235 millions d'exemplaires à ce jour selon Rockstar Games et a généré environ 10,8 milliards de dollars de chiffre d'affaires depuis sa sortie, selon le cabinet MoffettNathanson.
Les analystes de la banque Wells Fargo tablent sur 65 millions d'exemplaires de GTA 6 achetés d'ici la fin de l'exercice fiscal de Take-Two Interactive, fin mars. La sortie de GTA 6 aura nécessité plus de huit ans de développement , ponctuée de plusieurs reports et des fuites. « Nous sommes extrêmement touchés par l’accueil que nous ont réservé les joueurs du monde entier », a déclaré Sam Houser, fondateur et président de Rockstar Games. Aucune sortie officielle n’est prévue en Russie, au Qatar ou en Chine, où les autorités n’ont pas autorisé sa commercialisation.
Sur Metacritic, le jeu obtient une note moyenne de 99 sur 100 sur la base d’une centaine de critiques de la presse spécialisée. Forbes salue « l’univers de jeu vidéo le plus impressionnant » jamais créé, tandis que The Verge estime que GTA 6 « réussit l’impossible : être à la hauteur de l’engouement qu’il suscite ».

articles.t: Avec 3,79 milliards de dollars en une journée, GTA 6 dépasse déjà les prévisions basses
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 atteint 3,79 milliards de dollars de ventes au lancement. Rockstar revendique un record historique, avec 32,5 millions de copies vendues avant sa sortie.
articles.txt:
Le scénario le plus prudent pour une semaine entière a été dépassé avant même la fin de la première journée. Le prochain enjeu pour Rockstar Games sera de mesurer la durée de cette ruée, alors que les joueurs sur ordinateur attendent encore leur tour.
Grand Theft Auto VI a généré 3,79 milliards de dollars de ventes au détail le 19 novembre , jour de sa sortie mondiale. Ce montant ne vient plus d’un cabinet extérieur : il repose sur les propres estimations de Rockstar, arrêtées à la fin de cette journée.
Le studio présente ce résultat comme le « plus grand lancement de l’histoire du divertissement », tous supports confondus, cinéma, musique et télévision compris. Les 3,79 milliards de dollars représentent environ 3,49 milliards d’euros, avec une conversion indicative de 1 dollar pour 0,92 euro utilisée ici.
En 2013, Grand Theft Auto V avait rapporté environ 800 millions de dollars durant ses premières 24 heures , soit quelque 736 millions d’euros au même taux indicatif. Le nouvel épisode atteint donc près de 4,7 fois ce montant, alors que son prédécesseur avait lui-même battu plusieurs records.
Rockstar confirme également 32,5 millions d’exemplaires vendus avant la sortie , un record que le studio revendique toutes plateformes confondues. Il ne précise toutefois pas combien de copies correspondent aux 3,79 milliards de dollars : ce chiffre d’affaires au détail et le volume enregistré avant le lancement restent deux indicateurs distincts.
L’accueil critique accompagne ce démarrage commercial. Au moment des chiffres rapportés, le jeu affiche une note de 99 sur Metacritic , tandis que la revue de presse citée recense 118 notes maximales.
Quelques jours avant la commercialisation, Sensor Tower estimait les précommandes à environ 15 millions d’unités. Les 32,5 millions de ventes avant sortie communiquées par Rockstar donnent une tout autre échelle au lancement, même si les deux chiffres ne portent pas sur la même date d’arrêté.
Newzoo prévoyait pour sa part entre 3,3 et 5,2 milliards de dollars de ventes sur l’ensemble de la semaine de lancement, soit environ 3,04 à 4,78 milliards d’euros. La première journée dépasse donc déjà la borne basse de cette fourchette. Sony et Xbox avaient chacun confirmé que le titre était le jeu le plus précommandé de l’histoire de leurs boutiques respectives, le PlayStation Store et le Xbox Store.
Ce résultat est obtenu avant l’arrivée d’une version PC, évoquée pour le début de l’année suivante, au premier trimestre 2027. Ce calendrier reste rapporté comme une information non officialisée, contrairement aux ventes communiquées par Rockstar.
La distinction entre précommandes et ventes supplémentaires sera déterminante pour lire la suite : une première journée aussi élevée concentre aussi une demande accumulée avant la sortie. Le rythme des semaines suivantes permettra de mesurer ce qui relève de cette concentration initiale, puis l’apport du PC constituera une nouvelle étape commerciale.

articles.chapeau: The hacker behind the 2022 Grand Theft Auto VI breach claims to have released a dumped Xbox build of the game. The claims remain unverified, and Rockstar Games has not commented.
articles.txt:
Save Advertisement Advertise on LavX News See options The hacker behind the 2022 Grand Theft Auto VI breach claims to have released a dumped Xbox build of the game. The claims remain unverified, and Rockstar Games has not commented.
The hacker behind the 2022 Grand Theft Auto VI breach claims to have released a dumped Xbox build of the game online.
The individual, who uses the handle "teapotuberhacker," posted on an online forum claiming to have released a dumped Xbox build of the game. No one has verified the claim, and Rockstar Games has not commented on the alleged release.
A dumped build typically refers to a copy of a game extracted from development hardware, such as an Xbox dev kit, rather than a retail disc. Such builds often include debug menus, unfinished assets, and unencrypted code that retail versions lack.
The leaker posted more than 90 videos of early GTA VI gameplay online in September 2022, along with source code from Grand Theft Auto V. After the breach, the FBI and the City of London Police opened a joint investigation. Police arrested the individual, and a court found him guilty of multiple charges tied to the 2022 breach and other cyberattacks. The court sentenced him to an indefinite hospital order.
Viewers of the 2022 leak already saw large portions of the game's early development, including its Vice City-inspired setting and two playable protagonists. Developers debated security practices at major studios in the leak's aftermath.
If the new claim holds up, a full build shared outside Rockstar's control would mark a more serious breach than the 2022 footage leak, which consisted of video clips rather than playable code. Security researchers have warned that leaked builds can contain proprietary engine code, asset pipelines, and authentication systems. Exposure of those materials creates risks beyond copyright infringement.
Rockstar Games has not responded to requests for comment. The company said it was disappointed by the 2022 leak but that the incident would not affect the game's development timeline.

articles.chapeau: The alleged Xbox files do not establish a playable PC version. Cyberleek ties the missing executable's release to a countdown and its crypto token.
articles.txt:
Cyberleek claimed on November 19 to have released a 209 GB Xbox development build of Grand Theft Auto 6 , but the alleged package reportedly lacks its main executable.
The listing labels the package “XBOX BUILD 1.0.2.1 (NOV 2026).” Screenshots circulating on social media appear to show development files for Grand Theft Auto VI, although the package’s authenticity remains unconfirmed.
Rockstar’s open-world crime adventure launched on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S that same day.
Without the executable, the package cannot be launched as a playable game. Cyberleek says it has withheld that file on a countdown, naming November 23 as its planned release date. The group also says it will release the executable earlier if its cryptocurrency reaches a valuation target.
Cyberleek frames its campaign against Rockstar as a consumer-rights effort, citing opposition to GTA 6’s digital-only release. Its conditions for releasing the missing file tie access to the group’s own token.
The group previously shared authentic GTA 6 gameplay clips before launch. It also solicited crypto donations and required payments from people who wanted to vote in polls deciding what it would leak next.

Cyberleek says they will release the missing executable after a countdown completes, or earlier if their crypto hits a $15 million market cap. They claim PC emulation of GTA 6 is already running at about 30fps. In the latest twist in the race to get GTA 6 unofficially running on PC, Cyberleek, the same person or group behind leaks surrounding the game from earlier this year , claims to have released a November 2026 Xbox build of the game. According to reports, the game files are available online via torrents (via Videocardz ).
Users on Reddit report that the leak features roughly 209GB of data. Screenshots of the directory structure are also circulating online. I haven't verified that the torrent is available (it's likely being shared through private trackers), but based on reports from various Reddit users, a build of GTA 6 (or at least files that look like it) seems to be out there.
Cyberleek says they'll release the missing executable file once a countdown expires, but that they'll drop it early if their shady Cyberleek cryptocurrency reaches $15 million in market capitalization.
Cyberleek says this is the game's Xbox build and that the community will have it "running far past 30fps" in a week. This suggests that PS5 firmware version 26.07-14.23 , which is required to play GTA 6, has already been cracked (or Cyberleek may have gotten the files from another source).
It's important to note that Xbox game files can't just be run on Windows. Although the Xbox Series X/S and modern Windows PCs use the same x86-64 CPU architecture, Xbox game files can't just be launched on a PC. Developers would need to figure out the console's encryption and recreate or replace the Xbox-specific system functions and graphics, similar to the efforts to get the Switch 2 Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake running natively on PC .
It's important to note that none of Cyberleek's claims have been independently confirmed. Earlier this week, an X user created a fake video showing GTA 6 booting on PC. The clip is actually just a performance overlay of the PS5 version of GTA V running on a computer, layered over GTA 6 's opening title screen.
While GTA 6 is now available on the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S, Rockstar has not announced a PC version. Rumors point to an official PC release arriving somewhere between six months and a year from now, similar to GTA V .

articles.t: CyberLeek: Over 355 Domains Spreading Fake Versions of GTA 6 for PC
articles.chapeau: The CyberLeek campaign uses more than 355 malicious domains to distribute fake GTA 6 PC launchers.
articles.txt:
A widespread cybercrime campaign is capitalizing on the huge anticipation surrounding Grand Theft Auto VI to trap unsuspecting PC gamers. Dubbed CyberLeek , the operation uses more than 355 domains and subdomains to promote fake launchers that supposedly allow the installation of a Windows version of GTA 6 .
These websites present the available software as a game leak or as an early version that can be run on computers. However, users who proceed with the download do not gain access to the highly anticipated Rockstar Games game. Instead, they download a compressed ZIP file that contains a malicious program disguised as a regular installer.
The campaign exploits a particularly effective bait: players' desire to try GTA 6 on PC before its official release for that platform.
The campaign's extensive infrastructure was discovered by researchers at the Vecert Foundation , who have been monitoring its activity since mid-October 2026. According to their findings, the operation experienced a notable increase in activity during November, using a large set of web addresses to spread the fake installers.
See also: JPMorgan Chase: Customer data leak – Visa, Mastercard also targeted
The number of 355 domains and subdomains was derived from the analysis of domain logs and digital certificates. It is important to clarify, however, that this does not correspond to 355 different malicious programs nor does it prove that corresponding numbers of users have been infected. It describes the size of the online infrastructure associated with the campaign.
Leveraging multiple domains is a common tactic in modern malware operations. When a website is detected and blocked by security companies or internet providers, campaign managers can move their activity to other addresses, keeping the distribution network active.
The researchers examined, among other things, a website that advertised a supposed version of GTA 6 for Windows 10 and Windows 11. The page was designed to appear as trustworthy as possible to visitors, but also to attract traffic through search engines.
To this end, it used SEO-optimized content and structured data, or page markup, presenting the fake launcher as software available for installation. At the same time, a prominent download button promised immediate access to the file, without annoying ads or redirects.
This approach attempts to create the impression of an organized and reliable download service . In reality, however, a website's appearance in the first search results is no guarantee of security or authenticity.
Additionally, the download button did not always lead to the same website. Depending on the case, visitors could be redirected to different public file hosting links , and there was also an alternative local ZIP file.
This technique makes it significantly more difficult to detect and block the threat . Even if a security company blocks a specific download link, the home page may remain active and continue to direct users to other sites.
CyberLeek is part of a broader category of attacks that leverage popular games, apps, and tools as bait. Cybercriminals know that seeking out unofficial releases, free copies, betas, or exclusive content creates opportunities to distribute malware .

GTA 6 is a particularly attractive target, as it is one of the most anticipated games of recent years. Users' desire to gain access to a PC version can lead them to websites that they would otherwise view with greater suspicion.
Previous investigations have documented different campaigns using fake versions of GTA 6. One of them found a combination of password-stealing , remote access software, and code that could cause file corruption. In a separate case, analysts identified Vidar , a known infostealer that can collect credentials and data from browser sessions.

articles.chapeau: The Cyberleek GTA 6 leak allegedly dropped a 209GB Xbox build minus its executable, tied to a $15M token goal and a Nov. 23 date. Facts vs claims.
articles.txt:
Image: Rockstar Games A day after Grand Theft Auto VI reached players, the anonymous leaker known as Cyberleek is back with a claim that has the gaming press scrambling. According to IGN’s report , the persona has allegedly released a near-complete Xbox build of the game, while holding one crucial file back for now. The Cyberleek GTA 6 leak is the top gaming story on November 20, 2026, and it is also a story with very little verified detail attached.
Reports describe a download of roughly 209GB, labeled “XBOX BUILD 1.0.2.1 (NOV 2026)”. The package reportedly lacks the main executable, which means nobody can run it today. Cyberleek ties the release of that file to a $15 million market capitalization for its own cryptocurrency token, and also names a calendar date, November 23, 2026, as the day the executable goes out no matter what the token does.
We covered the first wave of this story in our earlier piece on the alleged 209 GB Xbox build and the missing executable . This analysis takes a different angle. It focuses on the countdown, the financial lever Cyberleek is pulling, what the leak could and could not mean for the game’s launch, and how readers should separate fact from noise over the next three days. Every specific below comes from the named outlets and the verified record. Where the record is silent, we say so.

Add Shattered once in the Google app and our stories show up in your news suggestions.
The coverage agrees on the outline. Cyberleek is the name of the anonymous leaker or group at the center of the story. The alleged files are described as an Xbox build of Grand Theft Auto VI, labeled “XBOX BUILD 1.0.2.1 (NOV 2026)”. Outlets including IGN, Eurogamer.net, PC Gamer, Notebookcheck and VideoCardz have all published on the claim, and Nacionale and Wolf’s Gaming Blog have carried it too.
Eurogamer’s headline frames the drop as a full development build of the game , and describes the group as infamous and back after an earlier appearance. That word “back” matters. It tells readers the persona has a history of making claims about Rockstar’s work, and the press is treating this release with both attention and caution.
The size figure comes up in nearly every report. A package of about 209GB is large enough to resemble a real console game install. Size alone proves nothing, though. A torrent of that weight could contain genuine game data, a mix of old and new material, or filler. No outlet in the verified record says it ran the build, inspected it file by file, or matched it against a retail copy.
The package also reportedly carries a name in the usual release-group style, with the build number and the Cyberleek tag attached. Naming conventions like that are free to copy. Anyone can label a file anything. That is why the story, as of today, rests on what Cyberleek says and what outlets have relayed, not on what independent analysts have tested.
The detail that gives this story its shape is the missing main executable. Reports say the alleged package does not include it, so the build cannot be launched as it stands. Cyberleek’s own framing is that everything else is out and one file waits on a countdown.
From a pure leverage standpoint, this is a clever structure. A leaker who dumps every file at once has nothing left to bargain with. A leaker who holds back the single piece that turns data into a running program keeps attention, keeps pressure and keeps a reason for people to come back. IGN’s headline captures the tension directly, saying the leaker is holding a crucial file back for now and threatening to release the game’s executable within days.
An executable is the entry point. Without it, the assets, scripts and libraries sit on disk like parts without an engine block. That is why reporters describe the package as unplayable today. It does not follow that the rest of the files are worthless. Data can be studied, compared and mined for information even when no one can run the game.
It also does not follow that the executable, once released, would make the game playable on any hardware. An Xbox build targets console hardware and a console operating environment. Notebookcheck’s headline argues the release makes a playable PC port more realistic , which is a statement about plausibility, not a demonstration. Nobody has shown a working PC version, and the verified record contains no evidence of one.
